params.name: N
params.reference: number of elements in input vector(s)

params.name: incx
params.reference: If $\mathrm{INCX} > 0$, $X(1+(i-1) \, \mathrm{INCX}) = x(i)$ for $1 \le i \le n$ If $\mathrm{INCX} < 0$, $X(1-(n-i) \, \mathrm{INCX}) = x(i)$ for $1 \le i \le n$ If `INCX = 0`, x isn't a vector so there is no need to call this subroutine. If you call it anyway, it will count x(1) in the vector norm N times.
